quote: “The greatest benefit we owe to the artist, whether painter, poet, or novelist, is the extension of our sympathies.”
source: George Eliot, The Natural History of German Life, Westminster Review, July 1856; in The Essays of George Eliot, ed. Sheppard (1883), essay V
